svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.19.2.1 Access
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.19 ROOF SPACES
Access

g.text: Open space 600 mm (23⅝″) or more high
over 3 m² (32.3 ft²) or more, 1 m (3′-3⅜″)
or more in length or width: an access
Open space: between the insulation and
When a hatch is required, Sentence (1)
One dwelling unit: 0.32 m² (3.44 ft²) or more, no

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Every attic or roof space has an access hatch
where the open space measures
(a) 3 m² (32.3 ft²) or more in area, (b) 1 m
(3′-3⅜″) or more in length or width, and (c) 600
mm (23⅝″) or more in height over at least that
area.
"Open space" is the space between the
insulation and the roof sheathing
The hatch is required where the space is large
enough for visual inspection. An uninsulated
space may meet the size, yet once filled with
insulation it may not be easily inspected,
particularly in smaller buildings or under
low-sloped roofs. See also Article 9.36.2.6.
The hatch is not less than 550 mm by 900 mm
(21⅝″ × 35 7/16″), except that where it serves
not more than one dwelling unit it may be
reduced to 0.32 m² (3.44 ft²) in area with no
dimension less than 500 mm (19 11/16″)
Hatchways to attic or roof spaces are fitted
with doors or covers.
Drawn: A half the roof, pink on the cut only. B and C seen from the attic, cover set aside. Other sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.19.2.1. (page 9-137), with Note A-9.19.2.1.(1)
